answer: A payout is split so that 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The haven schedule is applied in vault and inlet makes public each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2750 identities would post 2910 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
